title: 2026 F1 Bahrain GP in Malaysia race analysis by Peter Windsor
description:
Peter analyses the key elements of a hectic day at the stunning Sepang circuit, venue of the Bahrain GP in Malaysia.  After a slow start on intermediates in the wet, Max Verstappen went on to score his first win of the season for Red Bull-RBPT Ford, decisively beating the Mercedes of Kimi Antonelli.  Sir Lewis Hamilton and Ferrari chose to start on Pirelli slicks but, after sinking to P18, Lewis recovered brilliantly eventually to finish third.
